_meta.v3_1_changelog: MAJOR PRICING FIX. Root cause: engine was anchoring on Cashify REFURBISHED-RETAIL (sell) price, which produced buyback quotes that were too LOW after deductions. Fix: new 'cashify_exchange' field = what Cashify actually PAYS the customer (their exchange/sell-old-phone value), and new Mode 0 in engine: RT buyback A1 = cashify_exchange × (1 + RT_premium). RT pays a tier-based premium ABOVE Cashify (S:8% A:10% B:12% C:14% D:16%) to beat Cashify's lowball and win the walk-in. 100 high-traffic models now have verified/estimated Cashify exchange values (iPhone 11-16 series, Samsung S23/24/25 Ultra+S24, Z Fold 5, OnePlus 11/12R/10 Pro). Verified anchors: iPhone 14 ₹14,720, Samsung S24 ₹22,000. Both JS engine and Python engine updated with Mode 0.

market_signals.rule: When a successor flagship is confirmed <~4 weeks out, trim outgoing-gen resale anchors 5-10%; once it actually launches, drop the anticipatory trim and re-anchor on observed resale. (1) Removed 7 phantom RAM/storage variants that a dedicated find+critic pass positively disproved at high confidence, each with the real India line-up named (OnePlus 15R 8GB \u00d72, OnePlus 13T 16/512 — India got the 13s instead, Oppo Reno 15 8/512, Nothing Phone (3) 12/512, Vivo X200 FE 12/512, Moto Edge 70 Pro 12/512). Buyback Value' widget is a template printing a flat 40% of the listed price — identical ratio reproduced on Fold8, Fold8 Ultra and iPhone 17 Pro Max. (3) Nine of the largest rise-capped models were re-checked: the iPhone 17 Pro cluster was NOT confirmed (low confidence, buyback/resale ratios of 85-90% that RT's own guardrail treats as junk, and Cashify pages quoting \u20b91,37,900 against Apple's real \u20b91,49,900), so no iPhone rise was granted and iPhone 17 Pro 256 was trimmed to the lower verified figure. 5 models re-anchored on hand-verified resale.

A 7th (iQOO 15R 12/256) rested on an absence-of-listing argument and was KEPT. All 9 agents agreed the prices are REAL — 2026 India budget pricing has genuinely stepped up (iQOO Z10 ₹21,999 → Z11 ₹34,999; Tecno Pova 7 Pro ₹19,999 → Pova 8 Pro ₹49,999; Poco M7 ₹10,499 → M8x ₹20,999).
